inst.title: Install VoidStation
inst.offlineOk: Everything comes from the stick – you only need internet later for updates.
inst.almost: Almost ready – one setting is still missing.
inst.cantHere: Unfortunately VoidStation can't be installed on this device.
inst.whatShareText: Folders for ROMs, music and videos – reachable from your Windows PC
inst.minSsd: At least 16 GB of space on the SSD
inst.fw1: Restart and open the setup – usually with F2 or Del
inst.fw2: Turn off Secure Boot and save
inst.fw3: Pick the stick again in the boot menu (usually F12)
inst.needRam: VoidStation needs at least 4 GB of memory.
inst.needDisk: No suitable SSD found: internal, at least 16 GB. USB drives are not offered.
inst.wipeWarn: The selected SSD will be erased completely.
inst.biosWaysText: This PC was started in BIOS mode (Legacy/CSM). In this mode VoidStation can only be installed on a whole SSD. For dual boot or your own partitions, start the PC from the stick in UEFI mode: in the boot menu (usually F12) pick the entry marked “UEFI:”.
inst.blockedHibText:
Windows is only sleeping (Fast Startup or hibernation) and must not be shrunk like this.

In Windows: hold Shift and choose “Shut down” – or turn off Fast Startup in the power options. Then boot from the stick again.
inst.blockedDirtyText:
The Windows drive is scheduled for a check.

Start Windows once (it will check the disk), shut it down normally and boot from the stick again.
inst.noDisks: No internal SSD with at least 16 GB found.
inst.keepsBeside: EFI partition, the boot manager of {os} and all other partitions
inst.ntfsNote: On its next start Windows checks the disk once – that's normal.
inst.keepsFree: {os}, its EFI partition and its boot manager
inst.moreSpaceText: Free up space in the other system first, or use a second SSD
inst.gpartedOpen: GParted is open – close it to continue here
inst.manualNeed: Required: an EFI partition (FAT32) and a partition of at least 16 GB for VoidStation.
inst.manualMissing: Pick an EFI partition and a partition for VoidStation first
inst.name: Name
inst.greets: How the start page greets you
inst.pwInfo: The password is used for login, sudo and the Windows share.
inst.usbKb: A USB keyboard works too, of course.
inst.errName: Please enter a name that starts with a letter
inst.errHost: Computer name: letters, digits and hyphens only, at most 15 characters
inst.deviceSub: Everything is already set up sensibly – you can change it later in Settings.
inst.chTestSub: new versions first – may contain bugs
inst.tzSub: time is taken from the internet
inst.favSub: radio and TV from the live system
inst.rtcSub: local time, so Windows shows the right time
inst.hold: Hold A or Enter for 2 seconds
inst.holdHint: To start, hold A or Enter for 2 seconds
inst.sumBeside: {os} will be shrunk to {old}, VoidStation gets {size}
inst.sumFree: free space, VoidStation gets {size} – existing partitions stay
inst.progCapWhole: Erasing the SSD and installing VoidStation
inst.dontOffCaps: Please don't turn off the device.
inst.radioNone: You can listen to the radio after the installation.
inst.pleaseReboot: Please restart and unplug the USB stick
inst.phx.check: Checking the device and your choices – nothing has been changed yet.
inst.phx.shrink: Checking and shrinking the existing system. This can take a few minutes.
inst.phx.copy: Copying VoidStation from the stick to the SSD – the longest step.
inst.phx.configure: Setting up your account, language, Wi-Fi and share.
inst.phx.boot: Setting up the boot manager so the PC finds VoidStation.
inst.eta: about {min} minutes left · please don't turn off the device
inst.etaSoon: almost done · please don't turn off the device
inst.dontOff: please don't turn off the device
inst.tip1: With Win / Guide you get back to the start page from any app.
inst.tip2: Install new programs like Steam or Kodi later in the AppCenter.
inst.tip3: Updates show up as a yellow note in the bottom right – open with U / Select.
inst.tip4: Reach the share from your Windows PC at \\{host}\share.
inst.stateErased: SSD repartitioned – old data is gone
inst.stateNoBoot: Boot entry missing – won't start like this yet
inst.retrySub: from this step, without copying again
inst.noUsb: No writable USB stick found (FAT32, exFAT or NTFS)
inst.doneSub: VoidStation is installed. Unplug the USB stick and restart.
inst.loginAutoText: automatic as {name}, straight into the tiles
inst.updText: {channel} – a note appears in the bottom right
inst.tipText: Steam, emulators and Kodi are in the AppCenter, remote access (SSH) in Settings.
inst.err.not_live: The installer only runs from the VoidStation stick.
inst.err.bios_whole_only: In BIOS mode only “Use the whole SSD” is available. For everything else, start from the stick in UEFI mode.
inst.err.no_disk: The selected SSD or partition doesn't exist (anymore).
inst.err.live_disk: That's the stick the system was started from.
inst.err.too_small: Not enough space: VoidStation needs at least 16 GB.
inst.err.ntfs_hibernated: Windows isn't fully shut down (Fast Startup or hibernation). In Windows, hold Shift and choose “Shut down”.
inst.err.ntfs_check: The Windows drive couldn't be checked. Start Windows once, shut it down normally and try again.
inst.err.shrink_dryrun: The test run for shrinking failed – nothing was changed.
inst.err.shrink_verify: The file system isn't readable after shrinking.
inst.err.not_gpt: The SSD has no GPT partition table – please use “Whole SSD” or “Partition manually”.
inst.err.partition: The new partitions couldn't be created.
inst.err.esp_bad: The EFI partition isn't FAT32 – choose to format it under “Partition manually”.
inst.err.copy: Copying failed – is the stick OK?
inst.err.no_payload: A part of VoidStation is missing on the stick.
inst.err.setup: VoidStation couldn't be set up in the new system.
inst.err.no_kernel: The copied system has no kernel.
inst.err.efi_nvram: The firmware rejected the new boot entry.
inst.err.grub: The boot manager (GRUB) couldn't be set up.
inst.err.efi_fallback_taken: The default loader already belongs to another system – delete old boot entries in the firmware setup and choose “Try again”.
inst.err.bad_name: The name contains characters that aren't allowed (: , =).
inst.err.bad_manual: EFI and VoidStation partitions must differ and must not be on the stick.
inst.err.no_state: Nothing to continue – please choose again.
inst.bitlocker: Windows is encrypted with BitLocker – keep the recovery key ready, Windows may ask for it once.
inst.err.busy: An installation is already running – or something on the SSD is still in use.
inst.err.esp_foreign: This EFI partition holds another system's boot manager – it won't be formatted.

bt.hint: Put the device into pairing mode, then scan. AirPods: hold the button on the back (AirPods 4: double-tap the front) · PlayStation: Create + PS · Xbox: pair button · Switch: sync button
bt.typeCode: Type {code} on the keyboard and press Enter
bt.blocked: Bluetooth is blocked by the radio switch – “Turn on” lifts the block.
bt.err.auth: Pairing rejected – put the device into pairing mode again and retry
bt.err.timeout: Device is not responding – is it in pairing mode and close by?
bt.err.gone: Device no longer visible – restart pairing mode and scan again
bt.err.off: Bluetooth is off or not ready
bt.err.busy: Bluetooth is busy – try again in a moment
bt.err.profile: Paired, but the connection fails – turn the device off and on again
app.steam.desc: Steam in Big Picture mode for the TV, native from the Void repository (nonfree + multilib, 32-bit graphics drivers matching your GPU), plus the latest Proton-GE for Windows games.
app.steam.hint: On first launch Steam downloads updates and sets itself up – this can take a few minutes. After that it starts much faster.
app.retroarch.desc: All-in-one emulator for a huge number of consoles. RetroArch downloads emulator cores itself through its online menu.
app.duckstation.desc: PlayStation 1. Very accurate and fast, needs BIOS files in the folder share/bios.
app.ppsspp.desc: PlayStation Portable. Many games run smoothly even on older computers.
app.gba.desc: Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance. Put games into the share/ROMs/gba folder.
app.melonds.desc: Nintendo DS. Both screens side by side or on top of each other.
app.dolphin.desc: GameCube and Wii. Demanding – on weak computers only lighter games run smoothly.
app.scummvm.desc: Classic point-and-click adventures (Monkey Island, Indiana Jones …).
app.moonlight.desc: Stream games from your gaming PC to the TV (needs Sunshine or NVIDIA GameStream on the PC).
app.youtube-tv.desc: Experimental: youtube.com/tv with the big remote-control interface and phone pairing. Google may block it at any time.
app.ard.desc: Shows and live streams from ARD (German public TV).
app.zdf.desc: Shows and live streams from ZDF (German public TV).
app.kodi.desc: Full media center for your own movies, series and music, with cover art and a library. Controller support and streaming add-ons come along.
app.gpicview.desc: Lightweight image viewer (GPicView) for the folder share/Bilder.
app.htop.desc: Shows processor and memory load (htop in the terminal).
app.heroic.desc: Games from Epic, GOG and Amazon Prime Gaming in one launcher – Windows games run through Wine/Proton, managed by Heroic itself.
app.lutris.desc: Game manager for everything: GOG, Humble, Epic, your own installs and emulators – with ready-made install scripts from the community.
app.itch.desc: Buy, download and play indie games from itch.io – many of them free.
app.prismlauncher.desc: Minecraft (Java Edition) with several separate instances and modpacks from CurseForge and Modrinth. Needs a Minecraft account.
app.steamlink.desc: Stream games from your own PC with Steam to the TV – Steam must be running on the PC.
app.discord.desc: Voice and text chat for gaming sessions.
app.pcsx2.desc: PlayStation 2. Needs a BIOS from your own console and a stronger computer – on weak hardware only light games run smoothly.
app.rmg.desc: Nintendo 64 – modern interface for Mupen64Plus, easy to use with a controller.
app.azahar.desc: Nintendo 3DS (successor of Citra and Lime3DS). Games must be decrypted.
app.cemu.desc: Wii U. Demanding – needs Vulkan and strong graphics; on weak hardware more for trying things out.
app.mame.desc: Arcade machines from four decades. Put ROM sets into the folder share/ROMs/mame.
app.supertuxkart.desc: Kart racing with Tux and friends – up to four players in split screen, fully playable with a controller.
app.supertux.desc: Classic jump ’n’ run in the style of Super Mario.
app.neverball.desc: Skill game: roll a ball through mazes by tilting the floor. Neverputt (mini golf) is included.
app.luanti.desc: Free block world (formerly Minetest). Luanti downloads game modes itself from its content database.
app.xonotic.desc: Fast arena shooter, online and against bots. Large download (about 1 GB).
app.hedgewars.desc: Turn-based hedgehog battle in the style of Worms – great fun with several people on one TV.
app.wesnoth.desc: Turn-based fantasy strategy with many campaigns. Best with a mouse.
app.openttd.desc: Build a transport empire (like Transport Tycoon Deluxe). The game downloads its graphics itself on first start. Best with a mouse.
app.jellyfin.desc: Client for your own Jellyfin media server – movies, series and music from the server on your network, with a TV interface.
app.plex.desc: Plex with its TV interface – for your own Plex server and the free Plex movies and channels.
app.spotify.desc: Stream music and podcasts. Can also be controlled from your phone (Spotify Connect).
app.freetube.desc: YouTube without ads and without a Google account – subscriptions stay on the device.
app.strawberry.desc: Music player for your own collection (e.g. in the folder share/Musik), with cover art, playlists and internet radio.
app.plutotv.desc: Free channels and movies, ad-supported – no sign-up.
app.netflix.desc: Netflix in full screen. Needs a subscription; playback on Linux up to 720p.
app.netflix.note: On the first video Firefox downloads the copy-protection module (Widevine). If a video does not start, wait a moment and reload the page with F5.
app.primevideo.desc: Amazon Prime Video in full screen. Needs a subscription; playback on Linux up to 720p.
app.primevideo.note: On the first video Firefox downloads the copy-protection module (Widevine). If a video does not start, wait a moment and reload the page with F5.
app.disneyplus.desc: Disney+ in full screen. Needs a subscription; playback on Linux up to 720p.
app.disneyplus.note: On the first video Firefox downloads the copy-protection module (Widevine). If a video does not start, wait a moment and reload the page with F5.
app.joyn.desc: German private TV (ProSieben, SAT.1, kabel eins and more) – live and on demand, much of it free.
app.joyn.note: On the first video Firefox downloads the copy-protection module (Widevine). If a video does not start, wait a moment and reload the page with F5.
app.rtlplus.desc: German private TV (RTL, VOX, ntv and more) – live and on demand.
app.rtlplus.note: On the first video Firefox downloads the copy-protection module (Widevine). If a video does not start, wait a moment and reload the page with F5.
app.twitch.desc: Live streams of games, music and more.
app.firefox.desc: Firefox as a normal browser with address bar and tabs – its own profile, separate from YouTube and the streaming apps.
app.chromium.desc: The free base of Google Chrome, from the Void repository.
app.brave.desc: Chromium-based browser with built-in ad and tracker blocking.
app.librewolf.desc: Firefox variant focused on privacy, uBlock Origin is already included.
app.missioncenter.desc: Graphical system monitor: processor, memory, graphics, network and running programs at a glance.
app.localsend.desc: Send photos, videos and files from your phone or PC to the device over Wi-Fi – no cable, no cloud. The app is available for Android, iOS, Windows and macOS.
app.antimicrox.desc: Map controller buttons to keyboard and mouse – for programs and games without their own controller support.
app.steam.note: On first launch Steam downloads itself (about 300 MB). For Windows games, once in Steam: Settings → Compatibility → choose GE-Proton.
